**5 rounds · 9 questions**

---

## Round 1 · DSA / Coding
<!-- round: dsa -->

_Data structures & algorithms on a whiteboard or shared editor._

| Question | Difficulty | Tags | Practice |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Merge intervals. | 🟡 Medium | `intervals` `sorting` | [LC](https://leetcode.com/problems/merge-intervals/) · [GfG](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/search/?gq=Merge%20intervals) |
| Meeting rooms II — minimum rooms required. | 🟡 Medium | `heap` `intervals` | [LC](https://leetcode.com/problems/meeting-rooms-ii/) · [GfG](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/search/?gq=Meeting%20rooms%20II%20%E2%80%94%20minimum%20rooms%20required) |
| Word search II. | 🔴 Hard | `trie` `backtracking` | [LC](https://leetcode.com/problems/word-search-ii/) · [GfG](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/search/?gq=Word%20search%20II) |

## Round 2 · System Design
<!-- round: system_design -->

_High-level architecture of a large-scale system._

| Question | Difficulty | Tags | Practice |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Design a leaderboard for millions of players. | 🟡 Medium | `redis` `ranking` | [GfG](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/search/?gq=Design%20a%20leaderboard%20for%20millions%20of%20players) · [Search](https://www.google.com/search?q=Design%20a%20leaderboard%20for%20millions%20of%20players) |
| Design a ride-sharing service like Uber. | 🔴 Hard | `geospatial` `matching` | [GfG](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/search/?gq=Design%20a%20ride-sharing%20service%20like%20Uber) · [Search](https://www.google.com/search?q=Design%20a%20ride-sharing%20service%20like%20Uber) |

## Round 3 · Low-Level Design
<!-- round: lld -->

_Object-oriented / low-level design of a focused module._

| Question | Difficulty | Tags | Practice |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Design a movie-ticket booking system (BookMyShow). | 🔴 Hard | `oop` `concurrency` | [GfG](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/search/?gq=Design%20a%20movie-ticket%20booking%20system%20(BookMyShow)) · [Search](https://www.google.com/search?q=Design%20a%20movie-ticket%20booking%20system%20(BookMyShow)) |

## Round 4 · Hiring Manager
<!-- round: hiring_manager -->

_Scope, ownership, and role-fit discussion with the manager._

| Question | Difficulty | Tags |
| --- | --- | --- |
| How do you evaluate and adopt a new technology? | — | `judgment` |

## Round 5 · Behavioral / HR
<!-- round: behavioral -->

_Values, collaboration, and past-experience (STAR) questions._

| Question | Difficulty | Tags |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Describe a time you had to deliver bad news. | — | `communication` `star` |
| Tell me about the hardest bug you have debugged. | — | `debugging` `star` |
